warnings: Type schedule with a printed จำนวน (count) per type — count is the printed number. Marks kept as printed (ป in a circle = door, น in a hexagon = window).

Widths: where two widths are printed (1.00/0.90, 0.90/0.80, 0.80/0.70) the outer one is the frame (width_m) and the inner one the leaf (leaf_width_m), same reading as house 95. Every height is measured from ระดับพื้นห้อง; door and window heads are at 2.05, น4's head at 2.15.
